mrd.text: On Mirrodin the mycosynth's vapor mutates the vedalken, who develop four arms and gills.

The Neurok use the Litera Phials to learn how to destroy vedalken drones, and at the Battle of the Synod they power down the drones and defeat the Synod, after which the leaders agree to an uneasy truce.

After Memnarch's fall the Synod reorganizes the vedalken into sanctives and Neurok revolts force cooperation, but when New Phyrexia rises, Jin-Gitaxias overtakes Lumengrid and turns conquered vedalken into a research library.

dst.text: In Darksteel, Memnarch shares a touch of his power with the vedalken in return for their service, creating a debt.
With Janus dead, Pontifex ascends to leadership of the Synod, but Orland orchestrates a vote returning the Vedalken Empire to a Republic and Pontifex is stripped of power.
Pontifex kills two of his former Synod council members and leaves swearing vengeance.
